# VLM photo-source fixtures

These eight pinned files expand the photo-scene gate benchmark with independent, visually difficult sources: monochrome lunar soil, low-color Mars imagery, dark space scenes, night photography, panoramas, and scientific composites.

`manifest.json` records the NASA image-library page, exact asset URL, credit, and SHA-256 digest for every file. The corpus builder verifies each digest before deriving a 720×480 clean/watermarked pair. The overlays are generated by this repository and are not part of NASA's originals.

NASA's media usage guidelines apply. No file in this directory contains user data or a project secret.
